english.title: Fail to comply with stop notice within time limit specified
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person on whom a stop notice was served under paragraph 11 of Schedule 2 to the Control of Trade in Endangered Species Regulations 2018, failed to comply with that notice within the time specified in the notice
